paragraphs.text: DeepSeek account balance and peak/off-peak pricing whale in the DSH sidebar footer.
# dsh-balance-whale
A whale in the DSH sidebar footer that shows your DeepSeek account balance, a live countdown to the
next price switch, and whether you are on peak or off-peak pricing.

- **Peak** — the whale is drawn bright and tilted, and the countdown runs in the peak colour.
- **Of

f-peak** — the whale is drawn pale and curled, and the countdown runs in the off-peak colour.
- A li

ve `HH:MM:SS` between the whale and the balance counts down to the next switch, and the whale
change

s pose the moment it reaches zero.
- The balance refreshes **by itself** every 30 seconds, and immed

iately when the window regains
focus or the page becomes visible. Nothing to click.

The screenshots above are stills. In the running app the whale moves: it bobs and turns while the
pr
ice is at peak, and breathes slowly while it sleeps off-peak.

Hover the chip for the full picture: the price multiplier, the clock time of the next switch, the
re
charge/bonus split, and how long ago the number was read.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Prebuilt tarball, pinned to a release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

There is no build step and there are no dependencies — the package is plain JavaScript, so
installin

g it never asks you to approve build scripts. After a page refresh the chip appears beside
Settings
in the sidebar footer.

Requires a DSH build where you are signed in to a DeepSeek account (Settings → Account). Without a
s
igned-in account the chip shows `—` and says so in its tooltip.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`) reads the signed-in account's Platform wallets through the harness
acco

unt service and serves them as JSON on one loopback route, `/plugin/deepseek-balance`, cached
for 10

seconds. The browser never receives a credential.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) registers a chip

in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot, polls that
route, and draws the whale inline as SVG. Styles use

the host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so
it follows light and dark themes.
A failed read never blanks the number: the last good balance stays on screen while the next attempt
runs, retrying at 4s, 8s and 16s before settling back to the 30-second cadence.
## Pricing rule

Peak is **Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time** (UTC+8), with half-open ranges
(1

2:00 sharp is already off-peak). Everything else is off-peak at half price, and weekends plus
Chines

e public holidays are off-peak all day. The rule and the whale artwork come from
DeepSeek Status.

The switch is computed in the browser and re-armed exactly on the boundary, so the whale changes
pos
e on the minute rather than up to a poll late.
## Privacy
- No telemetry, no analytics. The only network request is the balance read the host performs through

your existing Platform sign-in.
- The route returns wallet totals and timestamps only, is served fr

om the same origin, and sends no
CORS header, so other sites cannot read it.

much more: a floating corner widget with usage accounting, p

er-turn cost, alerts, sounds and balance
templates for 30+ providers. If you want any of that, use i

This plugin is deliberately the small one: a chip in the sidebar footer that shows the balance and
t

he current price period, with no panel, no settings, no extra files and no network beyond the
balanc

ent price period, with no panel, no settings, no extra files and no network beyond the
balance read.
## Notes

- The whale is the DeepSeek mark, taken from the Simple Icons collection
(CC0). "DeepSeek" and its l

ogo belong to their owner; this is an unofficial widget.
- The Chinese public-holiday calendar is em
bedded (2025–2026). A new year needs a new release.
